own_solution.law: Snell's law plus Fresnel p-polarised reflectance; P_t = P0 (1 - r_p^2)

defect_reasons.other: The cancellation relation 'transmitted intensity I_t = I0 (1 - R) per unit area of the beam' is loose, since the refracted beam's cross-section and the transmitted intensity differ from the incident ones; the power-transmittance result 1 - R and the cancellation of area are nonetheless correct.

notes: Verified: r_p = -0.32675, R_p = 0.10677, 1 - R_p = 0.89323; P_t = 5 x 0.89323 = 4.4662 mW; 6.7 mW -> 5.9847; 8.4 mW -> 7.5032; 11.2 mW -> 10.0042 mW, all matching.
